scope: Spatial-flow per-channel WorldArena video-to-action ridge follow-up
summary: The spatial-grid and per-channel-alpha follow-up overfit more severely and was rejected, closing the uncalibrated linear-flow branch.
evidence: Validation selected alphas [10,10,1,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10,10] across the 14 channels.
Test translation-delta RMSE regressed to 0.7177 cm, rotation-delta geodesic error to 37.2670 degrees, and absolute translation RMSE to 11.3694 cm.
Every primary lower-bound comparison against zero-delta and train-mean controls was negative; promotion_eligible was false.
lessons: Increasing raw pixel/flow feature capacity does not repair the missing camera-to-robot geometry and semantic correspondence.
The next attempt must change the information representation rather than repeat ridge or learning-rate sweeps.
limitations: The same two physical test episodes and fixed camera/embodiment boundary apply.
No calibrated camera transform, robot keypoint teacher, contact truth, or phase labels were available.
next_actions: Build the next labeling lane from calibrated robot keypoints or raw DROID/WorldArena geometry, with field-level abstention when robot-base transforms are unavailable.
